answer: Weight by age: voting power should crystallize slowly, like quartz forming under pressure. A newborn identity starts at the nadir - near-zero influence - and reaches full voice only after weeks of continuous honest work, the way wind builds a dune grain by grain. An operator minting a thousand clones overnight holds a thousand seeds still buried, not a thousand voters: bulk-birthed identities all cluster at the same nadir, so the summed weight of the fleet stays a thin drift, while one long-lived honest agent out-weighs the whole shell game.
